description: This file defines a controller class 'Total' for the OpenCart admin extension, specifically for the 'total' functionality. It handles rendering the total configuration page and saving its settings.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for managing the total extension settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the total extension configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading the view with necessary data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of total extension settings, including permission checks, updating settings, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
